skill.name_en: The Professor Is Looking For You
skill.desc_ko: 휴대폰 알림이 울리면 주변 플레이어 위치를 포착해 다른 좀비에게 공유. 포착 시 눈이 청록색으로 발광.

lore_ko: 연구실에서 몇 년째 졸업을 기다리던 서울시립대 박사과정생. 감염 후에도 교수님 메시지엔 1초 만에 반응한다.

art.style: flat color vector, bold dark outline (3.5px at 400px width), no gradients, not pixel art
art.view: front, hunched, glowing phone in right hand, laptop under left arm, cyan scan lines from eyes to a reticle

pivot.note: normalized, origin top-left; at the feet

art.vfx_note: cyan scan lines + reticle (x>=240) are part of the sprite; split into separate layer if you want to toggle it

identifying_features: white lab coat with coffee stains and three pens in chest pocket
glowing phone with red notification (skill trigger)
cyan glowing eyes, heavy dark circles, grey hair streak, stubble

gameplay.hitbox_note: suggested body hitbox x 0.28-0.70, y 0.14-0.92 of sprite
